item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Oct 18 - 24, 2026)
item.description: A week dominated by PHP2Shell: two critical memory safety bugs in core PHP, found with AI assistance, plus the emergency releases and a messy fight over the disclosure. Around it, eMudhra’s certificate authority collapse, OpenBSD 8.0 and a good batch of ports, radio and desktop material. PHP2Shell and AI-Found Vulnerabilities PHP2Shell - Landing page for the two CVEs in core PHP (out of memory handling and stale global state) reaching CVSS 9.
